shared.nullMeans: unavailable, undefined or incomplete; never automatically zero
shared.money: integer minor units per ISO currency; aggregate server-side before display rounding

query.timezone: IANA identifier; proposed venue default Asia/Colombo, backend configuration authoritative
query.currency: ISO 4217; proposed local presentation LKR; no cross-currency sum without approved FX

envelope.currency: ISO currency or null for nonfinancial dataset
envelope.warnings: safe machine codes with display mapping
envelope.data: typed dataset below; empty array vs unavailable/null distinguished

financialBuckets.capturedMinor: signed integer sum in one currency

roomSnapshot.rooms: array {roomId, state: occupied|available|cleaning|maintenance|unknown, stateObservedAt, bookable}; one state per room

bookingStateBuckets.stateCounts: map actual backend state → nonnegative integer

financialSummary.previous: same sums and exact prior range or null

serviceHealth.entities: array {id, status: online|degraded|offline|unknown, observedAt: instant|null, staleAfterSeconds: positive integer, required: boolean, safeReason: string|null}

deviceHealth.entities: array {deviceId, roomId, enabled, status, observedAt, staleAfterSeconds, safeReason, telemetrySchemaVersion}

charts.name: Revenue and Bookings Chart
charts.formula: Revenue = sum successful captured payment minor amounts - successful refund minor amounts, allocated to their respective financial event bucket; bookingCount = distinct booking IDs with confirmedAt inside bucket. Counts and money have separate event/date bases.
charts.contract: financialBuckets + bookingBuckets joined on exact start/end; never infer bookings from transaction counts.
charts.axes: X local bucket label; left money/currency; right integer booking count. Both start at zero; signed financial axis may extend below zero.
charts.tooltip: Bucket start/end/timezone, recognized revenue with currency, confirmed bookings, financial event basis and completeness.
charts.legend: Revenue bar and bookings line, visible with series toggle and equivalent table.
charts.responsive: Full width; minimum 240px plot; reduce ticks, stack legend; dual-axis labels retained, table available.

charts.name: Room Occupancy Donut Chart
charts.formula: Snapshot occupancy = occupied bookable rooms / (occupied + available bookable rooms) × 100. Denominator excludes cleaning, maintenance and unknown; show excluded count. Donut slices show all rooms in scope, not just denominator. No eligible rooms yields N/A.
charts.contract: roomSnapshot with mutually exclusive states, stateObservedAt and snapshotAt; explicit unknown/stale handling.
charts.axes: No axes. Center labels operational snapshot occupancy and eligible denominator; never confuse with time utilization.
charts.tooltip: State, room count, share of all snapshot rooms, snapshotAt; unknown excluded from eligible rate.
charts.legend: All five states with counts; occupied violet, available green, cleaning amber, maintenance red, unknown gray.
charts.responsive: Minimum 240px graphic; legend below <lg; counts and table readable without hovering.

charts.name: Revenue Trend Chart
charts.formula: Same financial event revenue definition as revenue-bookings; area is decorative transparent series color, not cumulative revenue.
charts.contract: financialBuckets with capturedMinor/refundedMinor/recognizedRevenueMinor and optional comparable previous buckets.
charts.axes: X bucket/date; Y money/currency; zero baseline and negative values preserved.
charts.tooltip: Bucket, captured, refunds, recognized revenue, currency, completeness and optional comparison.
charts.legend: Recognized revenue; previous period dashed only when data supplied.
charts.responsive: Full width; fewer ticks; area may be removed at small widths without removing values.

charts.name: Popular Time Slots Chart
charts.formula: Distinct confirmed noncancelled booking IDs whose scheduled start falls within selected range, grouped by configured local hour band. Explicit business bands [startHour,endHour); cross-midnight bands split or carry dayOffset. Popularity is count, not occupied minutes.
charts.contract: slotBuckets with bandId, label, startHour/endHour/dayOffset and bookingCount; band definitions from configured operating hours.
charts.axes: X labelled local time bands (24-hour or locale time); Y integer booking count from zero.
charts.tooltip: Band including AM/PM or 24-hour clarity, booking count, range and timezone.
charts.legend: Bookings started; label rankings as tied when counts equal.
charts.responsive: Horizontal bars at <sm; preserve complete time-band labels; no ambiguous duplicate 9–12.

charts.name: Room Utilization Chart
charts.formula: For each room: union of noncancelled confirmed booking intervals intersected with sellable intervals and range, divided by union of sellable intervals within range × 100. Sellable intervals = configured operating intervals minus maintenance/blackouts and policy-defined turnaround. Count interval overlaps once. Zero sellable minutes → null/N/A.
charts.contract: roomUtilization with roomId/name, bookedMinutes, sellableMinutes, utilizationPercent and completeness; server resolves blackout/buffer policy.
charts.axes: Y room label; X 0–100 percent. Never cap invalid >100 data silently; flag contract error.
charts.tooltip: Room, booked/sellable minutes, percent, excluded intervals and range/timezone.
charts.legend: Time utilization; optional comparison dashed, not another occupancy definition.
charts.responsive: Vertical list of horizontal bars; long names wrap and table remains available.

charts.name: Booking Statistics
charts.formula: Cohort = distinct booking IDs with createdAt within range; snapshot state at asOf partitions cohort once. Total = sum all mutually exclusive state counts including other. Cancellation rate = cancelled cohort / total cohort × 100; zero cohort → N/A. Separate confirmedAt KPI is not interchangeable with this creation cohort.
charts.contract: bookingStateBuckets with cohort basis createdAt, asOf and all backend states mapped to documented display buckets; totals from same dataset.
charts.axes: X creation bucket; Y integer booking count, zero baseline.
charts.tooltip: Bucket, each state count, cohort total, cancellation rate, asOf.
charts.legend: All included states, with text and stable color; Other states expands in data table.
charts.responsive: Stacked chart stacks above summary cards <lg; table retains unmapped states.

charts.name: Financial KPI Cards
charts.formula: Captured = sum successful captures in event range; refunded = sum successful refunds in event range; recognized = captured - refunded. Average booking value = sum finalized quote totals of bookings confirmed in range / distinct such bookings, rounded for display only; excludes cancelled-at-asOf cohort and labelled asOf. Denominator 0 → N/A. Period delta = (current - previous) / abs(previous) ×100; previous 0 or missing → N/A. Revenue may be negative.
charts.contract: financialSummary including sums, confirmedQuoteTotalMinor, eligibleConfirmedBookingCount, previous comparable range and asOf; all amounts per currency.
charts.axes: No axes; each card has label, value/currency and named comparison basis.
charts.tooltip: Metric definition, date basis, previous exact period, completeness, asOf.
charts.legend: Not required; label every card. Up/down is descriptive, not always good/bad.
charts.responsive: 1/2/4 columns base/sm/lg; values wrap without truncation.

charts.name: System and IoT Status Indicators
charts.formula: Device state from authoritative health policy and lastSeen: stale after per-type threshold, unknown when never observed; connectivity alone does not imply command success. Fleet online rate = online / registered enabled scoped devices ×100, unknown included; 0 devices → N/A. System operational only when all required checks explicitly healthy and fresh; missing/degraded checks forbid operational claim.
charts.contract: serviceHealth and deviceHealth with status, observedAt, staleAfterSeconds, required, safeReason and telemetry schema version.
charts.axes: Status list has no axes; optional timeline X instant/date, Y state per service/device lane.
charts.tooltip: Entity, status, observedAt/timezone, age, freshness threshold and safe diagnostic.
charts.legend: Online/degraded/offline/unknown with icons and words; no all-green default.
charts.responsive: List wraps to cards; timeline scrolls in labelled region; equivalent event table.
